title: Cost of Attendance Builder
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Build a college's cost of attendance from tuition, room and board, and indirect costs, and compare how residency and housing choices change the total.

learningObjectives: Students will break down a cost of attendance into direct and indirect costs and compare how residency and housing choices change the total.

keyQuestions: Why would a student who looks only at tuition underestimate the real cost?
Which costs on the chart can you control, and which can't you?
Why do indirect costs still matter even though the college doesn't bill them?
commonMisconceptions: Tuition is the whole price of college.
Costs the college doesn't bill aren't part of what college costs.
assessmentOpportunities: Students break a published cost of attendance into direct and indirect costs and explain how one residency or housing change affects the total.
